title: Rhinos and palms in the Miocene
text: The rocks around Red Rock Canyon preserve fossils from the Miocene, between about 13.5 and 7.3 million years ago. They include horses, camels, and three kinds of rhinoceros, along with a shovel-tusker named Serbelodon burnhami. Fossil plants include oak, cypress, and a palm.
